pipeline: Reference sheet: Tripo image tool, GPT Image 2.5, 16:9, 4K, 1 image, the painted draft portrait Art/DraftPortraits/Painted/<id>.png as the identity reference, prompt = Art/ChampionHQ/Briefs.json sheetTemplate (free: 0 credits, 21/1000 free image quota used).
Sheet cut in-page into FRONT / RIGHT profile / BACK crops (GPT drew both profiles facing image-right, so the LEFT slot is left empty; Tripo: 'left means the left arm of the character').
Model: HD Model, multi-view (front/right/back), H3.1 Best Quality, Ultra Mesh Quality, 8K PBR texture, Remove Lighting, Quad topology 50,000 faces (~100k triangles): 70 credits.
Rig: Humanoid auto-rig, UE5 Mannequin preset (20 credits); preset clips retarget free. Export: FBX (Blender axis preset), 4K textures, skeleton + all clips, DCC Bridge 'Send To Unreal'.

fusedPartsAudit.result: Champion sheets were weapon-free by brief, so every HQ weapon, shield and staff is already a separate prop (WeaponLoadouts.json, closed-hand CireGrip). Capes, coats and hoods are skinned cloth on the UE5 rig and move with it. The only fused prop is the Ranger's quiver.
fusedPartsAudit.skeleton: All 20 HQ humanoid champions plus the Oathbound Guardian and Spectral Companion use Tripo's Humanoid UE5 Mannequin preset (UE5 bone names: hand_r, index_01_r, spine_03...). The GDH / Gun & Sword / Crossbow sets retarget through the IK rigs (RetargetChampionAttacks). The golems and behemoth also use the humanoid preset. The grave hound uses Tripo's 'Other' quadruped rig.

Detailed segmentation isolated the quiver as tripo_part_7 (arrows) + tripo_part_16 (tube) on 2b9fbccc-3f9e-4ffd-90d5-9598f0d209fa (40 + 40 credits)
Deleting the quiver left an open strip on the back; Fill Parts > Quick Cap (free) closed it (version 09-26 00:02, 140,255 faces; the patch has a smeared texture that the re-attached quiver hides)

Quiver: save the 23:53 history version as a new model, keep only parts 7 + 16, and send it unrigged as SM_RangerQuiver (keep its position)

Add exports rows (ranger -> export CTS_ChampHQ_RangerB, folder RangerB; SM_RangerQuiver -> folder Props/RangerQuiver, kind prop), run the pipeline --only, point WriteChampionHQArtRows 'ranger' at folder RangerB, and add to the ranger row: "staticParts": [{"mesh": "/Game/Tripo/ChampionsHQ/Props/RangerQuiver/SM_RangerQuiver.SM_RangerQuiver", "bone": "spine_03"}] (UCireChampionArt::ApplyStaticParts places a mesh-space part on its bone's bind pose; use offsetCm/rotation if Tripo recentred the part)
